# Keep the create-response shape policy explicit

1108 factors CreateItem response processing for sending and saving and rejects any response-message count other than one. The historical save path also requires one returned item. Accepted current create_message instead calls single_response_or_error: zero responses fail, while extra responses cause a warning and the first is used; the required item ID is still checked separately. Preserve the policy of the code being edited and distinguish response count, response class, item count and identifier handling. Do not describe the current helper as rejecting extra responses. No malformed server response was replayed.

Scope: EWS create response cardinality validation.
